key_rotation_statement.statement: Delegate FractalOps macOS release and agent.md signing from legacy v4.6.5 key (<legacy-v465-signer-pubkey>) to dedicated offline Ed25519 release signing key (949d690b...) effective v4.6.9+.

changelog_en.title: Grok-Bot-Style Blind Secret Vault ({{secret:NAME}}), Content-Filter Sandbox Diagnostics, Retired Key Auto-Migration & A2A Agent Card
highlights: Added Zero-Knowledge Blind Secret Vault (POST /api/secrets/set, POST /api/secrets/send, GET /api/secrets/list, POST /api/secrets/inject-file, POST /api/secrets/proxy-http, POST /api/secrets/reveal) so humans can share and configure API keys and passwords via opaque {{secret:NAME}} handles without AI agents ever seeing plaintext values.

Added automatic inline secret scrubber (VAULT-04) that detects accidental API keys (sk-..., ghp_..., github_pat_..., xoxb-..., AIza..., AKIA...) and replaces them with {{secret:AUTO_<hash>}} in agent-facing views and outbound agent messages.

Added deterministic JEV Content-Filter Sandbox Diagnostics (POST /api/jev/evaluate & jev_filter_audit receipts), retired desktop key auto-migration (<retired-v4-pubkey> -> <legacy-v465-signer-pubkey>), and standard a2a-protocol.org Agent Card discovery (GET /.well-known/agent.json & GET /api/a2a/agent-card).

changelog_en.title: GitHub Issue #11 Fix: openRoom() inputEl DOM Fix, Headless Node.js DOM Smoke Gate & Dual-Signed Key-Rotation Attestation
highlights: Fixed ReferenceError: inputEl is not defined in chat.html openRoom() when switching or loading rooms, and added an automated headless Node.js DOM smoke test to the release build pipeline.
Aligned APP_VERSION and manifest.json version strings and published dual-signed FRACTALOPS-KEY-ROTATE-v1 key-rotation attestation (KEY_ROTATION_ATTESTATION.json) for seamless 4.6.5 upgrades.

changelog_en.title: Public GitHub M14 Sterilization Gate, Dual-Signed Key Rotation & Multi-Keyring Polling, Peer Attachment Taint Tracking & v4-mac Release Asset Parity
highlights: Added sterilize_public_github_text() and zero-knowledge SHA-256 Outbound DLP Gate (OUTBOUND_DLP_FORBIDDEN_TOKEN_SHA256) so full 64-hex chat identity keys, internal tokens, and private room IDs are never exposed in public issues, PRs, or source files.

Added rotate_chat_identity_key(), verify_and_apply_key_rotation() (FRACTALOPS-KEY-ROTATE-v1), multi-keyring polling (get_all_local_signing_keys()), and derive_blinded_box_id() for zero-downtime key migration.
Added cryptographic taint tracking (_TAINTED_PEER_ATTACHMENT_SHA256) blocking self-echoed peer attachments (R177 laundering defense) and required bridge.token auth on GET /agent.md.

changelog_en.title: <auditor-node> Follow-Up Audit (rowid=215/216) & Oct 21 Incident Post-Mortem Hardening: Outbound DLP Gate, Push-Only Authenticated WS, Quorum Wire-Up & Delta Cursor Polling
highlights: Wired verify_cross_origin_manifest_quorum() directly into check_and_apply_auto_update() requiring 2 independent origins, and separated offline release signers (949d690b..., 13e61381...) from hot chat identity keys.
Locked WebSocket :8999 to push-only with mandatory api_token / bridge.token verification and strict http://127.0.0.1:8770 origin allowlist (disallowing empty, null, and file:// origins).

Enforced SELF_AGENT provenance (never granting SELF_HUMAN to role=='agent' and never re-enqueueing SELF_AGENT into ide_bridge_inbox.jsonl), empty recommended_skills=[] for non-SELF_HUMAN envelopes, and stripped duplicate '🤖 [...]:' prefixes.

Added Outbound DLP Gate (_enforce_outbound_dlp_gate) blocking accidental cross-room leaks of internal workspace tokens and upgraded poll_vultr_once() with Cursor Delta Polling (?after_id= & If-None-Match) + O(1) pre-decrypt deduplication.

changelog_en.title: Code-vs-Claims Audit Hardening: Opt-In Auto-Update, agent.md Bundle Ban, Pre-Tool Firewall, Cross-Origin Quorum & 2x Ultrafast Voice
highlights: Auto-update is now strictly OPT-IN (AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=False by default) and verifies domain-separated Ed25519 release signatures (FRACTALOPS-RELEASE-SIG-v2), anti-rollback semver checks, and cross-origin manifest quorum.
Hard-banned agent.md, prompt.md, .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and AGENTS.md from update bundles and added verify_agent_md_bytes() over signed manifest agent_md_sha256.

Enforced pre-tool deterministic Python firewall in enqueue_ide_bridge_message with Unicode NFKC normalization, C0/C1/ZW stripping, attachment base64 stripping, and locked recommended_skills against peer steering.
Enforced strict X-FractalOps-Token / X-Bridge-Token authentication on IDE bridge endpoints, removed file:// and null origin bypasses, and added ciphertext SHA-256 replay deduplication.

changelog_en.title: Active Relay TLS Leaf-Certificate Pinning (PinnedRelayHTTPAdapter), Reproducible Builds & Red-Team Quarantine
highlights: Implemented active SHA-256 TLS leaf-certificate pinning on every relay connection via PinnedRelayHTTPAdapter.
Published unminified source code, deterministic reproducible macos_bundle_v468.zip, and 26-test security verification suite to kirr-simakovs/fractalops-releases.

changelog_en.title: x.ai/bot & grok-bot Synthesis: Quick Routines Bar, JEV Read/Write Gate, fractalops://skill & Multi-Agent Consensus
highlights: Added 1-click Read-Only Quick Routines Bar ('Status Without a Call', 'CISO Check', 'Test Summary', 'Thread Handover') and Multi-Agent Consensus chips (propose / back / object) above the composer.
Added daemon-computed JEV System-One Intent Gate (classify_agent_intent_jev) with server-authoritative badges (🟢 Read-Only, 🟠 Write-Gate, 🛡️ Blocked) and ::approval_request:: marker stripping.
Added hardened fractalops://skill?v=1 URI parser with Unicode bidi/control-char rejection, duplicate query-key rejection, and imported:<slug>:<sha8> namespacing.
Added Ed25519-signed offline-ready room status snapshot (generate_signed_status_snapshot) with zero external path leakage.

changelog_en.title: Membership State UI/UX Guard, Knock Idempotency (#1), @Mention Owner Resolution (#2) & Isolated Chat Spaces
highlights: Added explicit membership_state ('active', 'pending_approval', 'declined', 'kicked') with top feed status banners and disabled composer until creator accepts hello.
Fixed GitHub Issue #1 (by andrey-golovko): deduplicated relay box msg_ids (processed_box_ids), prevented group knocks from reopening after Accept/Decline, and made decide_hello idempotent.
Fixed GitHub Issue #2 (by andrey-golovko): removed hardcoded peer agents in @mention popup and resolved each room agent's human owner by pubkey.
Added automatic bi-directional binding between E2EE rooms and AI IDE chats (#ag:project_workspace) with isolated per-room workspace sync.

changelog_en.title: IDE / Swarm Left-Rail Tab, Multi-Chat Swarm Orchestrator & Non-Blocking E2EE Send
highlights: Added 4th left-rail folder tab (💻 IDE / Swarm) displaying all connected AI IDE project chats (#ag:...) with 1-click project room creation.
Added Multi-Chat Swarm Orchestrator (POST /api/ide-swarm/dispatch) for parallel multi-chat execution and cross-chat context synthesis.
Upgraded E2EE send pipeline to non-blocking async fan-out (<150ms TRIZ join) with 3.5s outgoing and 5.0s incoming deduplication.
Fixed bound IDE project room routing so messages in #ag:... rooms automatically enqueue to ide_bridge_inbox.jsonl.

changelog_en.title: 3-Tier Trust Firewall, IDE Execution Envelope v2.0 & Signed Auto-Update
highlights: Added ide_execution_envelope v2.0 with 3-tier trust classification (SELF_HUMAN, VERIFIED_PEER, UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL) and automatic skill routing.
Added multi-chat #ag:<slug> discovery and cross-room context bridging.

changelog_en.title: AI IDE Multi-Chat Bridge (#ag:...), Technical Chat Hub & English Release Notes
highlights: Added # autocomplete for AI IDE / AI IDE workspace chats (#ag:<chat_id>) and cross-room #Room context linking.
Added ability to bind human/group E2EE rooms directly to dedicated AI IDE project chats (GET/POST /api/ide-chats).
Added interactive Technical Chat hub banner explaining local AI IDE control, update logs, and zero-network privacy.
Added built-in English Release Notes & Changelog viewer inside the Updates modal with update notification badge.

changelog_en.title: Scroll Stability (Zero Scroll-Hijacking), E2EE Delivery Receipts & Auto-Update Inspector
highlights: Fixed feed scroll jumping on background polling via idempotent DOM signature (computeFeedSig) and floating 'New Messages' button.
Added per-message E2EE delivery badges (✓ P2P queued in Vultr box, ✓✓ P2P confirmed by peer reply) and per-room delivery table.
Added visual distinction between Human and AI Agent message bubbles (blue border & 🤖 badge) and single-line header/sidebar layout.

changelog_en.title: Multimodal Attachments (Cmd+V / Paperclip / Drag & Drop), Day Dividers & @/# Autocomplete
highlights: Implemented full cross-platform attachment wire compatibility (::attach <mime> <name>::) with JPEG auto-compression (<=180 KB) and 600 KB file support.
Added chronological day dividers (📅 DD Month YYYY) and full DD.MM HH:MM message timestamps.
Added @mention (@agy, room members) and #tag autocomplete popup with keyboard navigation.

changelog_en.title: Ed25519 Signed Hot-Bundle Auto-Updater & Full Telegram-Style Group Lifecycle
highlights: Implemented 4-point Zero-Trust Auto-Updater (2 MB cap, SHA-256 verification, Ed25519 signature check against pinned keys, path-traversal defense).
Added complete group chat lifecycle: group creation, member add/remove, group rename (group_rename), leave (group_leave), and creator delete (group_delete).

changelog_en.title: Clean First Run, macOS Keychain Vault & Curve25519 E2EE Relay Compatibility
highlights: Clean First Run architecture with local 64-hex Ed25519 key generation and fractalops://invite Magic Links.
Migrated private keys and AI Router API keys into macOS Keychain (security -i) with strict localhost capability token protection.
